name: codex-worklog
description: Preserve model-authored context, decisions, checks, and next steps in a daily local worklog.

interface.shortDescription: Complete work blocks in a daily diary
interface.longDescription: The working model authors structured context, chronology, changes, decisions, checks, and next steps. Hooks validate and commit daily append-only notes; the read-only skill recovers local history.
defaultPrompt: Recover task context from the workspace worklog and verify what is still true.
Check whether this plugin's local lifecycle hooks are installed and healthy.
